properties.value:
Ribbit, ribbit...hello young traveller, I can give you some tips if you need some.
You can light up torches by walking up to them and pressing the Action button.
You can run by holding the Action button while moving.
Lighting certain torches may help you progress.
Some walls are not what they seem.
What, you want more? The game comes with a manual with more help.
